System.Threading.Tasks.Task.java: Same namespaces/casing; properties become get_*. No selected public Task constructor. Creation is owned by TCS and private CompletedTask factory. Do not add public completion/setter helpers or fake Task.Run/Wait/Dispose implementations.

System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCompletionSou.java: Same names; get_Task returns same owned instance. Exception means System.Exception, not arbitrary java.lang.Throwable. Default constructor only.

System.Runtime.CompilerServices.TaskAwai.java: Follow class-backed ValueTask awaiter and existing System.Action convention. Native constructor is internal; any necessary Java public constructor is explicitly a representation helper outside selected native API. Do not introduce java.lang.Runnable as the public .NET continuation type.

System.Threading.Tasks.TaskStatus.native: enum TaskStatus { Created=0, WaitingForActivation=1, WaitingToRun=2, Running=3, WaitingForChildrenToComplete=4, RanToCompletion=5, Canceled=6, Faulted=7 }
System.Threading.Tasks.TaskStatus.java: Use existing raw Int32 carrier convention, constants/Equals/$raw/hashCode; raw values are data, never interpreted as permission to create unsupported states.

System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledExcep.java: Selected constructor accepts null task, retains exact task reference, copies its cancellation token, sets native default message via base; inherited HRESULT is COR_E_OPERATIONCANCELED. Other native constructors and serialization are not required by this slice.

boundaries: No complete Task API/interface/reflection parity: IAsyncResult/IDisposable, computational constructors, Start, Task.Run, Factory, ContinueWith, Wait/WaitAll/WaitAny/WaitAsync/Delay/WhenAll/WhenAny, Id/AsyncState and disposal omitted rather than faked.
No TaskCreationOptions or RunContinuationsAsynchronously constructor in this slice; default pending continuation behavior and late queueing are real source-backed selected behavior.

No SynchronizationContext, custom TaskScheduler, ExecutionContext/AsyncLocal capture, debugger/ETW, thread-pool fairness/stack-growth/finalizer unobserved-fault events, or CLR process-fatal callback policy equivalence.

No generic Task/TCS, compiler async builders, Java struct default/copy representation, generic arity lowering or source API closure. Java public awaiter constructor/internal bridge is a documented representation helper.

No exception-list overload ordering, SetFromTask copying, static FromException/FromCanceled factories, configured awaiters, ValueTask.AsTask/Preserve/new ValueTask(Task), CancellationTokenSource.CancelAsync, registration async disposal or WaitHandle.
Java null CancellationToken has no native value-type equivalent; document as out-of-profile representation input and do not present any invented normalization/exception as observed .NET behavior.
Race matrix establishes bounded observations, not formal proof or exhaustive native concurrency parity. Queue scheduling and callback order remain nondeterministic; no timing throughput guarantees.
Task Exception wrapper identity and CompletedTask reference identity are implementation details; only selected relation observations may be reported.

steps: Dedicated worker calls pending GetResult; establish WAITING using bounded handshake/state inspection.
Interrupt owned worker, prove it has not returned, then complete producer in finally.
Bounded join; successful GetResult and restored interrupt flag must both hold.
Fresh JVM first operation constructs TCS, obtains Task awaiter and registers/completes; no prior ValueTask bridge warmup.
Inspect six-source API and compiled public signatures for no public System completion mutation and no replaceable/global task registry.
Install temporary default uncaught-exception handler retaining exact exception and signaling bounded gate.
Register a throwing callback plus a normally-returning callback, complete Task; SetResult must return normally.
Observe exact failure via uncaught handler, remaining callback once, successful task state; restore handler and release gates in finally.
Use an isolated Java-only fixture; do not execute fatal callback on CLR.
